facts.value: the keeper of the lodging-house at 9 Tanner's Row
facts.quote: I am Ada Orme, the keeper of the lodging-house at 9 Tanner's Row
Mr. Fenn lives there
and Captain Rudd too
Nobody but me and those two lived there
The rent box stood in the dining-room
At one o'clock on Tuesday, the week's rents were in the box
At three o'clock on Tuesday, they were not
Captain Rudd was at 9 Tanner's Row from one o'clock on Tuesday until four o'clock on Tuesday
Captain Rudd told me this, and told it plainly
At half past two on Tuesday, Mr. Fenn was in the yard
The back door was open at half past two
Mr. Fenn knocked at the front door at four o'clock on Tuesday
Mr. Fenn told me, and plainly
I was at the reading room in Cable Street at half past two on Tuesday
Mr. Fenn went out by the front door at one o'clock on Tuesday
From one o'clock on Tuesday until four o'clock on Tuesday, that door was locked
I had the key of it for the same hours
I was in the kitchen from one o'clock on Tuesday until three o'clock on Tuesday
In those same hours, from one o'clock on Tuesday until three o'clock on Tuesday, the back door was shut. I saw this from the kitchen.
Later on Tuesday, the week's rents were in Captain Rudd's sea-chest

facts.value: owns to taking up the week's rents
facts.quote: Captain Rudd said to the constable: "It was I who took the rents from 9 Tanner's Row."

facts.value: owns to telling Ada Orme a thing that was not so
facts.quote: He said to the constable too: "I was the one who told Ada Orme a thing that was not so."
